meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw 群组装上 mcp-remote 桥接并注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务,让 agent 多出 tavily_search(网页搜索)和 tavily_extract(网页正文提取)两个工具,全程不需要 API key。
howto.when: 当你给某些 NanoClaw agent 群组安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取、且不使用 API key 时触发。

say.text: 给 group-1 装上 Tavily 搜索,不用 API key
say.note: 会加桥接依赖并注册 tavily 服务器

say.text: 把 Tavily 的网页提取也加到 group-1
say.note: 注册后 Search 与 Extract 都可用

say.text: 再帮 group-2 配一份同样的 Tavily
say.note: 按同一套命令逐个群组注册并重启

howto.what_en: Installs the pinned mcp-remote bridge and registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, exposing tavily_search and tavily_extract with no API key.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for selected NanoClaw agent groups without an API key.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search to group-1 with no API key
say_en.note: Adds the bridge and registers the tavily server

say_en.text: Also give group-1 Tavily URL extraction
say_en.note: Enables both Search and Extract tools

say_en.text: Set up the same Tavily for group-2
say_en.note: Registers and restarts each selected group
